standard.tooltip:
A game experience similar to the campaign.

Grow your aquarium through the ranks and unlock animals and equipment as you progress.

A different selection of animals will be available to unlock each time you play.

Randomised Side Objectives, Trades and Merchants offer opportunities to acquire a wider variety of animals and additional resources.
quickStart.tooltip:
An accelerated Standard game where you start with a higher Rank and access to more animals and equipment.

All animals are available to unlock but you can gain access to them sooner via Side Objectives, Trades and Merchants.
limitedSupply.tooltip:
An interesting game mode for veterans to explore.

Only a third of animals will be available in unlimited numbers from the shop. You'll need to obtain the rest via Side Objectives, Trades and Merchants.
fullUnlock.tooltip: In this mode you start with everything unlocked. However, you still need to build a profitable aquarium to survive.
researchMode.tooltip:
A relaxed mode where the pressure of profitability is taken away.

With unlimited funds, you can build anything you want. However, you start at only Rank 2 and will need to progress through the ranks as normal to unlock all the animals and equipment you'll need!
creatorMode.tooltip:
The ultimate sand box experience.

Everything is unlocked and you have unlimited money. Experiment as you see fit and build whatever it is your heart desires.
passiveMode.tooltip: Like Creator Mode but animals have no care requirements. Build tanks without worrying about compatibility or water quality. Animals cannot die so you can safely leave your aquarium running unattended.
fishAvailability.-1.tooltip:
You start the game with a selection of animals unlocked depending on your starting Rank.

Some animals can be unlocked once you reach sufficient Rank by earning Ecology <sprite name="ecology">.

Most animals can only be obtained via Side-Objectives, Merchants and Trades.
fishAvailability.0.tooltip:
You start the game with a selection of animals unlocked depending on your starting Rank.

Some animals can only be obtained via Side-Objectives, Merchants and Trades.
fishAvailability.1.tooltip:
You start the game with a selection of animals unlocked depending on your starting Rank.

Every other animal can be unlocked once you reach sufficient Rank by earning Ecology <sprite name="ecology">.

You can still acquire animals sooner via Side-Objectives, Merchants and Trades.
fishAvailability.2.tooltip:
You start the game with every animal unlocked, regardless of your starting Rank.

Side-Objectives, Trades and Merchants will no longer offer animals or Ecology <sprite name="ecology"> as rewards.
equipmentAvailability.0.tooltip:
You start the game with all equipment unlocked from Ranks up to but not including your starting Rank.

The rest of the equipment can be unlocked once you reach sufficient Rank by earning Science <sprite name="science">.

You can obtain some equipment sooner via Side-Objectives, Trades and Merchants.
equipmentAvailability.1.tooltip:
You start the game with every piece of equipment unlocked, regardless of your starting Rank.

Side-Objectives, Trades and Merchants will no longer offer equipment or Science <sprite name="science"> as rewards.
randomise.1.tooltip:
Make every game different by randomising animal availability.

This will vary which animals start unlocked, which can be unlocked with Ecology <sprite name="ecology"> and which can be obtained only via Merchants and Trades.

Has no effect if Animal Availability is set to Everything Unlocked.
negativePrestige.0.tooltip: The default way to play. When your animals die, you will earn negative Base Prestige. You can turn this setting off if you wish to play with fewer negative consequences.
careRequirements.-1.tooltip: Removes all care requirements from animals.
seed.tooltip:
The seed is used to randomise certain starting conditions.

If a new Sandbox is started using the same settings and seed, the following starting conditions will be identical:
•<indent=4em>Animals which start unlocked.</indent>
•<indent=4em>Animals which can be unlocked using Ecology <sprite name="ecology">.</indent>
•<indent=4em>Starting Side-Objectives, Trades and Merchants.</indent>

Only these starting conditions are controlled by the seed. The Sandbox evolves depending on the player's actions.
